output.title: nodeSelector quoting fix doesn't reach this environment's values
output.content: The change fixes how the Helm chart templates nodeSelector values (quoting them). The environment's 9 set values keys (replicaCount, webhook.timeoutSeconds, prometheus.servicemonitor.*, global.leaderElection.namespace, global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole) include no nodeSelector key. The values dimension is only "partial", so unlisted keys cannot be fully excluded. Based on the keys shown, the fix does not apply.
